facts.P1_fx_receipts: Yes; no forced sale of foreign currency, and service exports have no settlement deadline.
facts.P2_fcy_account: Yes: sole proprietors (FOPs) receive payments into a foreign-currency bank account.
facts.P3_local_gateways: LiqPay and WayForPay need FOP status or a company.
facts.L1_registration: Register as a FOP (sole proprietor), free and online in Diia in minutes.
facts.L2_tax_id: РНОКПП taxpayer number from the State Tax Service, shown in Diia.
facts.L3_income_tax_foreign: FOP group 3: 5% of revenue plus 1% military levy, up to UAH 10.09m.
facts.L4_vat_gst: 20% VAT above UAH 1m; most services to foreign clients are outside VAT.
facts.L5_data_protection: Law 2297-VI; notify the Ombudsman only for sensitive data like health.
facts.L6_consumer_ecommerce: Buyers can cancel within 14 days, but not after digital delivery they agreed to.
facts.L7_incentives: FOP single tax (5% plus 1%) instead of 18% plus a 5% levy.
facts.D1_id_document: Ukrainian ID card passport, also usable digitally in Diia.

watch_out.text: Move Payoneer money to your FOP account within the quarter, or pay 18% plus levy.
Services not on the Tax Code list may be charged 20% VAT.
PayPal may change its Ukraine services at any time because of the war.
